marks.gloss_en: כמאן? כהאי תנא, דתנן: כוורת הקש... מחזיקות ארבעים סאה בלח שהן כוריים ביבש -- טהורים
ארבעים סאה בלח שהן כוריים ביבש -- שמע מינה האי גודשא תילתא הוי
as Abaye reports Rabba's ruling in practice: even a basket of two kor he did not permit him to move
Abaye saw Rava gazing westward: והתניא כל זמן שפני מזרח מאדימין? -- the baraita names the east
מי סברת פני מזרח ממש? לא, פנים המאדימין את המזרח (= p_panim_hamaadimin)
Rava: 'the face of the east' is not the east itself but the face [of the sky] that makes the east red
'two parts' means two thirds of a mil
and [their positions are] the reverse regarding a wicker basket
R' Chiyya: one who wants to see Miriam's well -- let him go up to the top of the Carmel and look out, and he will see a sieve-like thing in the sea; that is Miriam's well
אילימא לרבי יהודה -- ספקא הוא: if it follows R' Yehuda, [his twilight] is a doubt
Shmuel: in R' Yehuda's twilight, priests immerse
אילימא לטבילה -- ספקא היא: if [the teruma ruling] is about immersion, that is a doubt
R' Yochanan: the halakha follows R' Yehuda in the matter of Shabbat
R' Yehuda's twilight ends, and then R' Yosei's twilight begins
R' Chanina: one who wants to know R' Nechemya's measure -- let him leave the sun at the top of the Carmel, go down, immerse in the sea and come up; that is R' Nechemya's measure
